## Ad Hoc Section Logic

- Source table: `gold.economics_industry_wide`
- Richmond pilot year: latest available Gold year, currently 2024
- X-axis: sector location quotient
- Y-axis: year-over-year QCEW private employment growth by sector
- Quadrants:
  - `rising_star`: `LQ > 1.25` and growth above zero
  - `mature_strength`: `LQ > 1.25` and growth at or below zero
  - `emerging_bet`: `LQ <= 1.25` and growth above zero
  - `declining_legacy`: `LQ <= 1.25` and growth at or below zero
